source_text_encoding: UTF-8 JSON decoded to extracted page text
offset_unit: Unicode code points in one extracted page, zero-based half-open

physical_block.raw_text: Exact page characters excluding the line ending
physical_block.line_ending: Exact page characters immediately following raw_text; may be empty only at end of page
physical_block.source_span: start/end cover raw_text only; an empty physical line has start equal to end
physical_block.reconstruction: In line order, concatenate every block raw_text and line_ending and compare byte-for-character with the extracted page text; blank lines are explicit blocks

page_serialization.rule: Insert exactly one form feed between serialized pages; it is a synthetic page boundary and is not a character in either page body

normalization.rule: Trim leading/trailing tab and space; replace each internal maximal run of tabs/spaces with one U+0020
normalization.mapping: Each identity output character maps to its exact one-code-point source interval; each collapsed output space maps to the full source interval of the whitespace run. Runs may coalesce adjacent identity mappings, but expanding them must yield one valid source interval for every normalized character.
normalization.coordinates: Source intervals are absolute page offsets; normalized intervals are zero-based offsets in normalized_text

relationship_policy.uncertainty: Oracle entries marked needs_review remain uncertain and are not converted to asserted parent or continuation relations
relationship_policy.cross_page_candidate: case-02 line 1 page 2 is preserved as a separate physical block; its possible continuation relation remains needs_review

scope_limit: Synthetic text fixtures only; no production-accuracy or real-PDF claim
